exposure: Entonox gas exposure during vaginal delivery
outcome: infant oxidative stress indices (malondialdehyde, thiols, total antioxidant capacity)
cohort: The study included 120 pregnant women undergoing natural labor, divided into groups with and without Entonox exposure, and their infants.
finding: There were no significant differences in the indicators of infant oxidative stress between the groups whose mothers were exposed to Entonox and those who were not.
